title: Elina Pilates Wall Board
overviewParagraph: The Wall Board is a wall-anchored, space-saving training unit that lets you perform countless exercises on a single machine. Its adjustable design adapts to different movements and user needs, helping you build a versatile workout setup without taking over your room. Made from high-end wood and aluminum, it combines an elegant look with durable construction for consistent use. Easy to use and ready to mount, it delivers a clean, efficient way to train at home or in a studio.
inclusions: A pair of soft foot loops
Side and central anchor points for spring attachment
Designed to be mounted flush to the wall
Dimensions: 55.5 cm X 180 cm X 7.5 cm. 80 cm (maximum width)
